paragraphs.text: Please provide the best rates upfront! We don't believe in doing rounds as it's a waste of time for you and us! In full transparency, IF YOUR STATION'S CPMS COME IN HIGH COMPARED TO THE OTHER STATIONS IN THE MARKET OR YOUR CPMS ARE HIGHER THAN WHAT WE PAID LAST YEAR, THEN ODDS ARE YOUR STATION WILL BE PASSED OVER. We are going to be hustling through these markets, with a goal of placing most if not all by the end of the year, so together we need to be efficient. I hate sounding harsh, but want to be honest so you don't risk the chance of being blindsided and left out. Thank you for your understanding of this!
